paper.title: Algorithm 801: POLSYS_PLP: A partitioned linear product homotopy code for solving polynomial systems of equations
paper.venue: ACM Transactions on Mathematical Software 26(1), 176 (TOMS 801, Mar 2000)

code.note: Fortran 90 shell archive (Fortran90/Dp/). Remove the header above the shar body and run it with sh to create Fortran90/ with polsys_plp.f90, lapack_plp.f, and the Drivers/ directory (main_template.f90, test_install.f90, INPUT.DAT, OUTPUT.DAT). Note: the archive's own OUTPUT.DAT is the reference used here. The claim does not use a fresh run of the shell archive's test_install.

claim.location: The shipped reference output Fortran90/Drivers/OUTPUT.DAT (member of 801.gz), first problem 'TWO QUADRICS, NO SOLUTIONS AT INFINITY, TWO REAL SOLUTIONS', the path whose output is 'REAL, FINITE SOLUTION' with X( 1) = ( 2.34233851959121E+03, -2.71046941433355E-11) and X( 2) = ( -7.88344824094120E-01, 9.12116375191414E-15).

reference.file: Fortran90/Drivers/OUTPUT.DAT (member of 801.gz), real finite solution with X(1) real part 2.34233851959121E+03

claim.metric: Real part of X(2) at the real finite solution of the first INPUT.DAT problem (TWO QUADRICS, real solution with X(1) near 2342.3385), compared with -0.788344824094120 from OUTPUT.DAT, absolute difference. The run must use the archive's INPUT.DAT and main_template.f90 with the default TRACKTOL 1e-4 and FINALTOL 1e-14 values from the input file.
claim.paper_value: Not used: the paper is paywalled and was not read.

values.name: TWO QUADRICS real finite solution, Re X(2)

tolerance.basis: Fixed before any run. The reference X(2) has magnitude 0.79 and FINALTOL is 1e-14, so the solver's own root accuracy is far below 1e-6. The tolerance absorbs (a) the start system drawn with RANDOM_NUMBER after RANDOM_SEED=32749, whose generator is compiler-specific, and (b) floating-point differences across compilers. The root set is unique, so a different path order is allowed. Not to be loosened after any run.

cost.cpu_minutes_estimate: Under 5 minutes: compile lapack_plp.f and polsys_plp.f90 with gfortran, then one run of the first INPUT.DAT problem.
cost.data_size: None beyond the archive (about 470 KB uncompressed).
cost.data_licence: Netlib TOMS code under the ACM licence; the rerun should record the licence text.

why: The shipped OUTPUT.DAT of a standard homotopy solver lists the roots of a small polynomial system, so one real root is a checkable number that the method must compute from the input coefficients.
